fleet.map.keyNoHazards: Nothing reported on the roads around your vehicles — which is not the same as the roads being clear.
fleet.map.readAt: Read at {time}; it reads itself again every 45 seconds while this screen is open.
fleet.map.keyBrokenDown: A red dot: {count, plural, one {# vehicle} other {# vehicles}} broken down — tap one for what happened.
fleet.map.dark: No position for {age}: the last place the phone reported is not where the vehicle is now.
fleet.map.hazardReported: Reported on {day}; {agree, plural, =0 {nobody has confirmed it yet} one {# other driver agrees} other {# other drivers agree}}.
fleet.map.hazardDisputedDetail: {count, plural, one {# driver says} other {# drivers say}} it is gone. It stays on the map until network staff clear it.
fleet.map.hazardBasis: What drivers reported, not a survey of the road.
fleet.dash.hoursLimits: Shift limit {limit} h · {rest} h rest between shifts
fleet.dash.overLimit: Over the {limit} h limit — no new load until the shift ends
fleet.drivers.onboardNote: Bike and motorcycle riders start immediately. Any heavier class needs a licence and a SeeBuyGet check first.
fleet.drivers.lightRegistry: Light registry — no licence or SeeBuyGet check needed.
fleet.drivers.rateHigh: {count, plural, one {# job} other {# jobs}} near them were more than the sender would pay at {rate}/km
fleet.drivers.rateHighNoRate: {count, plural, one {# job} other {# jobs}} near them were more than the sender would pay at this rate
fleet.kyc.title: Send this driver’s papers
fleet.kyc.lede: GLOS checks the numbers you typed against the documents. Photograph both, in good light, with all four corners in frame.
fleet.kyc.faceNote: Optional — a photo of their face becomes their badge picture, so a shopkeeper handing over a bag can see who they are expecting. You can add it later.
fleet.kyc.checkDetail: That the name, ID number, licence number and expiry you entered match the documents — and that the licence is still valid.
fleet.drivers.aloudPool: {count, plural, one {# driver} other {# drivers}} in the pool.
fleet.sessions.coupleNote: Pick a driver and a vehicle. It goes to the top of their list and they are told. The shift starts when the driver starts it, with their own PIN — nobody starts a shift for somebody else.
fleet.sessions.noCorridor: No corridor — local and marketplace work only
fleet.sessions.corridorNote: The bus route this shift serves. Leave it empty for local and marketplace work — but without a corridor, no shop counter can hand parcels to this driver.
fleet.sessions.noCorridorsYet: The network has not published any corridors yet, so this shift can only take local and marketplace work.
fleet.sessions.aloud: {sessions, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}} on duty. {drivers, plural, one {# driver} other {# drivers}} and {vehicles, plural, one {# vehicle is} other {# vehicles are}} free.
fleet.vehicles.registerNote: The vehicle gets its own ID and a dashboard QR — drivers scan it to start a shift. Full papers plus a factory number mark it verified (dispatch priority).
fleet.vehicles.equipmentHint: Needed to be offered heavy dedicated-freight jobs. Manual handling is always assumed.
fleet.vehicles.volumeHint: Measured inside the body: length × width × height. Light, bulky loads — flowers to an airport — fill a truck before they weigh it down; with this, a load that does not fit is not offered to it.
fleet.vehicles.deckHint: How high the loading deck stands off the road, empty. We need it to answer low bridges: what matters under one is the load plus the deck it sits on, so a 2.90 m high-cube on a 1.30 m chassis is 4.20 m of vehicle. Leave it blank if you have not measured it — we will say we do not know rather than guess, and a guess is what puts a roof through a bridge.
fleet.vehicles.baseFeePh: blank: your country’s, for this class
fleet.vehicles.minMultiplierAria: Lowest price multiplier, times your price per km
fleet.vehicles.maxMultiplierAria: Highest price multiplier, times your price per km
fleet.vehicles.multiplierRates: At your price per km, that is {low} to {high} per km.
fleet.vehicles.multiplierHint: The base fee starts every freight price. Busy-time demand may only flex the per-km rate between your two multipliers — you always own the floor and the ceiling.
fleet.vehicles.listNote: Print each QR and stick it on the dashboard. The per-km rate is open data — shippers quote against it.
fleet.checks.title: Upkeep rules
fleet.checks.require: Drivers check a vehicle before every shift
fleet.checks.hintOn: A shift does not start until the vehicle has been checked that day. A problem with brakes, tyres or lights keeps it off the road until you mark it fixed.
fleet.checks.hintOff: Drivers can check a vehicle before a shift, and report a problem at any time. Turn this on to make the check a must.
fleet.checks.serviceOffRoad: A vehicle overdue for a service stays off the road
fleet.checks.serviceHintOn: An overdue vehicle starts no shift, and plans leave it out, until a service is recorded under Upkeep. You are told when a service is coming due.
fleet.checks.serviceHintOff: You are told when a service is coming due, and again when it is overdue; an overdue vehicle can still go out.
fleet.vehicles.aloud: {count, plural, one {# vehicle} other {# vehicles}} in the fleet.
fleet.vehicles.qrBody: Print this and stick it on the dashboard. Drivers scan it to start a shift on this vehicle.
fleet.vehicles.priceBody: This vehicle currently charges {rate} per kilometre. The rate is public — shippers compare before offering work.
fleet.body.flatbedWhy: A flat open deck, no sides and no roof. Loaded from the side or lifted on from above, then strapped and sheeted.
fleet.body.dropsideWhy: A flat deck with low sides that drop down flat. Loads like a flatbed but holds loose goods in.
fleet.body.boxWhy: A closed box with doors at the back. Dry, lockable, loaded by forklift or tail-lift.
fleet.body.curtain_sideWhy: A box whose sides are heavy curtains that slide back. Dry like a box, but loadable along its whole length.
fleet.body.refrigeratedWhy: An insulated box with a cooling unit on the front. Holds a set temperature the whole way.
fleet.body.insulatedWhy: An insulated box with no cooling unit. Slows temperature change; it cannot hold a cold chain on its own.
fleet.body.tipperWhy: An open tub that lifts at the front and tips its load out of the back. Sand, gravel, spoil.
fleet.body.cement_mixerWhy: A turning drum that keeps wet concrete moving so it does not set on the way.
fleet.body.grain_hopperWhy: A sealed hopper that discharges grain through gates underneath, by gravity or auger.
fleet.body.bulk_tankerWhy: A sealed silo for powder — cement, flour, lime. Blown out under air pressure and never opened to the weather.
fleet.body.tankerWhy: A tank for liquids, filled and emptied by pump. General duty, not food-grade.
fleet.body.food_tankerWhy: A food-grade tank, certified and cleaned to carry milk, oil, juice or liquid sugar. It may carry nothing else.
fleet.body.fuel_tankerWhy: A certified tank for fuel and flammable liquid, with the compartments and earthing that requires.
fleet.body.water_bowserWhy: A water tank, usually with its own pump and hose. Site water, dust control, supply.
fleet.body.hazmatWhy: A body certified for dangerous goods — chemicals, corrosives — with the placards and papers to match.
fleet.body.car_carrierWhy: A multi-deck frame with ramps for driving vehicles on and off.
fleet.body.livestockWhy: A ventilated body with decks and ramps for live animals.
fleet.body.skeletalWhy: A bare steel frame that a shipping container twist-locks onto. It carries the container, never loose goods.
fleet.body.container_selfloaderWhy: A skeletal with its own cranes at each end, so it lifts a container off itself. No yard equipment needed.
fleet.body.craneWhy: A flat deck with a crane arm behind the cab. Loads and unloads itself, anywhere.
fleet.body.lowboyWhy: A trailer that sits very low between its wheels, so a tall machine still clears the bridges. One heavy piece that cannot be split.
fleet.body.loggingWhy: Bolsters and stakes for logs or long timber, usually with its own crane.
fleet.body.tow_recoveryWhy: A bed or boom for lifting and moving broken-down or damaged vehicles.
fleet.body.refuseWhy: A compactor body for waste collection.
fleet.body.unknownWhy: A truck body in the network catalogue.
fleet.vehicles.pickBodySheet: Which body is it? Look for the one that matches the truck.
fleet.logic.vMissingBothMult: Set both the lowest and highest price multiplier, or leave both blank.
fleet.logic.vMissingMultInverted: The lowest price multiplier cannot be above the highest.
fleet.logic.dMissingDisplay: Give the driver a display name.
fleet.logic.dMissingClass: Pick at least one vehicle class.
fleet.logic.dMissingLicence: Heavy classes need the licence number.
fleet.logic.dashboardSummary: {onShift} of {total, plural, one {# driver} other {# drivers}} on shift. {loads, plural, one {# load} other {# loads}} moving, {kg, plural, one {# kilogram} other {# kilograms}} in total.
fleet.toast.driverHeavyDetail: Heavy registry — submit the KYC papers next.
fleet.toast.kycSubmittedDetail: SeeBuyGet checks them and issues the badge.
fleet.toast.rateUpdatedDetail: Now {price} per km — public to shippers.
fleet.toast.lineProposedDetail: The network will publish it. Nothing runs on it until then.
fleet.toast.corridorSetDetail: This driver can take a shop-counter handover now.
fleet.toast.coupledDetail: They have been told. The shift starts when they start it, with their PIN.
fleet.notes.cardHint: Every note your trucks carried, frozen as it read at each signature — and the copies to hand a shipper, an insurer or an officer.
fleet.drivers.dupTitle.phone: This phone number belongs to a driver who is already registered
fleet.drivers.dupTitle.nationalId: A driver with this national ID is already registered
fleet.drivers.dupTitle.licence: A driver with this licence number is already registered
fleet.drivers.dupOffer: They cannot be added a second time. If this is the driver you mean, offer them a place instead: they say yes in their own driver app, and their licence and past trips come with them.
fleet.offers.title: Offer a place to a driver already on SeeBuyGet
fleet.offers.note: Type the phone number they sign in with. They say yes or no in their own driver app. Until they say yes you see only the number — and nobody joins your fleet any other way.
fleet.offers.phone: The phone number they sign in with
fleet.offers.sentToastDetail: They see it in their driver app. It stays open for 7 days.
fleet.offers.line.open: Waiting for their answer. Open until {day}.
fleet.offers.line.accepted: Number ending {ending}. They now drive for you — see them under your drivers.
fleet.offers.line.declined: They turned the place down. Nothing changed on your roster.
fleet.offers.line.lapsed: No answer by {day}. Offer again if you still want them.
fleet.remove.title: Take {name} off your fleet
fleet.remove.body: They can no longer start a shift on your vehicles or take work in your name. Every trip they did for you stays in your records. They are told, with the reason you give.
fleet.remove.reason.left: They no longer work for us
fleet.remove.note: In your own words — the driver is shown this
fleet.drivers.dupTypo: If the number is wrong, correct it above and add them again.
fleet.drivers.dupDispute: If the ID number is right and it is theirs, somebody else registered with it. The driver disputes that themselves, with their own phone: on any SeeBuyGet sign-in screen, “Trouble signing in?”, then “Somebody else registered with my national ID”. When it is decided for them, add them here with that same phone number.
fleet.adviser.title: Ask about this plan
fleet.adviser.what: Ask why the plan is the way it is, or say what should be different — "keep FRT-142 off KLM 808T", "start at six", "the small truck is in the workshop". The adviser is an AI. It explains the plan, and it asks the planner again; the plan itself is always worked out by the planner.
fleet.adviser.label: Your question, or what to change
fleet.adviser.placeholder: Why is this order left out?
fleet.adviser.changed: Changed in what the planner was asked:
fleet.adviser.unchanged: Nothing about the plan was changed.
fleet.adviser.changedBefore: Before it stopped, this changed: {what}. The plan below shows it.
fleet.adviser.sent: Your words and this plan — order codes, shippers' names, delivery addresses, weights and plates — go to the AI service to be answered. No phone numbers and no contact names are sent. Asking accepts nothing and sends nothing to a driver.
fleet.adviser.off: The adviser is not switched on for this service. The plan is complete without it — use "Change the day" to adjust it yourself.
fleet.adviser.failed.off: The adviser is not switched on for this service.
fleet.adviser.failed.busy: The adviser is busy. Try again in a minute.
fleet.adviser.failed.unreachable: The adviser could not be reached. Try again — the plan does not depend on it.
fleet.adviser.failed.declined: The adviser would not answer that. Try saying it another way.
fleet.plan.rules.title: Rules on this plan
fleet.plan.rules.putOn: {code} goes on {plate}, or on no vehicle
fleet.plan.rules.keepOffHint: To keep one order off a vehicle, or to put it on another, use Not on this vehicle and Move to under it in the plan below.
fleet.plan.rules.hint: A rule holds every time the day is planned again, until it is removed. No vehicle is ever overloaded to keep one.
fleet.system.cardOff: Your own transport system can be told each step of your orders, loads, vehicles and runs. Not set up.
fleet.system.cardOn: Told each step of your work, at {url}.
fleet.system.cardStuck: {n, plural, one {One message has} other {# messages have}} not arrived at your system.
fleet.system.title: Your own system
fleet.system.lede: Your own transport system can be told each step of your work, exactly as this app shows it: orders coming in and changing, loads put on a driver, picked up and delivered, a vehicle breaking down, space booked on a run, the day’s plan. A load carries its money only where SeeBuyGet pays you; nothing else about money is sent. Each message is signed with your secret, tried for about two days, and listed here with what became of it.
fleet.system.anyManager: Any manager of your fleet can do this. Each act is recorded under their name.
fleet.system.none: No address yet: nothing is sent.
fleet.system.signed: Signed with your secret, made by {name}, {when}.
fleet.system.secretOnce: Your signing secret. Copy it now: it is not shown again.
fleet.system.addressHint: Starting with https://. Leave it empty to stop the messages.
fleet.system.turnSecretWarn: Your system must be given the new secret: every message from now on is signed with it.
fleet.system.notArrived: It did not arrive yet. It is tried again by itself
fleet.system.nothingYet: Nothing sent yet. The next step of your work is.
fleet.system.pos.title: Where your vehicles are
fleet.system.pos.lede: Off unless you turn it on. When it is on, your system is told where each of your vehicles is while a driver is on a shift in it, at most as often as you choose. Each driver is told so in their app.
fleet.system.pos.off: Off: nothing about where your vehicles are is sent.
fleet.system.pos.on: Sent at most every {n, plural, one {minute} other {# minutes}} a vehicle. Turned on by {name}, {when}.
fleet.system.pos.lastError: The last one did not arrive: {why}. Each is tried once, and the next takes its place.
fleet.system.msg.retrying: Not arrived yet: tried {count, plural, one {once} other {# times}}, tried again by itself {next}.
fleet.system.msg.gaveUp: Not arrived: given up after {count, plural, one {one try} other {# tries}}. Put your system right, then send it again.
fleet.keys.title: Keys for your own system
fleet.keys.lede: With a key, your own transport system can read your orders and the day’s plan, send orders in (checked as an uploaded sheet is), read the board for a driver on a shift, and take a load off the board at its price. A test key runs every check and keeps nothing. Never what a person must decide: accepting a plan, agreeing a price, anything about money.
fleet.keys.anyManager: Any manager of your fleet makes keys and takes them away; each is recorded under their name.
fleet.keys.label: What it is for
fleet.keys.labelHint: The system that will hold it, such as "TMS".
fleet.keys.secretOnce: The key. Copy it into your system now: it is not shown again.
fleet.keys.revokeWarn: The next call your system makes with it is refused.
fleet.still.title: Standing still or silent
fleet.still.toCall: {n, plural, one {One to call} other {# to call}}
fleet.still.none: No vehicle on a shift is standing still, or silent, away from its stops.
fleet.still.offNone: Both watches are off: no vehicle is looked at.
fleet.still.watchOn: You are told when a vehicle on a shift stands in one place more than {minutes} where it has no reason to: away from its loads’ stops, your sites and the network’s hubs and shops, and not at a border or hub its driver has said it is at.
fleet.still.watchOff: Off: you are not told when a vehicle stands still.
fleet.still.silenceOn: You are told when the phone in a vehicle on a shift says nothing for more than {minutes}, last heard where it had no reason to be. The app says nothing while it is closed, or the phone is off or out of signal; the case ends by itself once it is heard again.
fleet.still.silenceOff: Off: you are not told when a phone on a shift goes silent.
fleet.still.settingLede: How long before you are told, for each. The driver is told in their app what each is set to. Any manager of your fleet can change them.
fleet.still.callFirst: Call the driver, then say how it was.
fleet.still.noAnswerStill: The driver did not answer. Try again, or send someone.
fleet.vehicles.borderTitle: For loads across the Moyale border (Kenya–Ethiopia)
fleet.vehicles.customsLicenceC40: C40 — other goods under customs control
fleet.passport.title: Passport of {name}
fleet.passport.body: For a load across the Moyale border between Kenya and Ethiopia: printed on its border manifest. Read it off the passport in the driver’s hand.
fleet.passport.name: Name, as printed on it
fleet.toast.passportSavedDetail: It is printed on the border manifest of the loads this driver takes across Moyale.
fleet.vehicles.plateBody: Write it as it is on the vehicle. The plate it had is kept on its record, and the runs it has not left on yet show the new one.
fleet.vehicles.plateSavedDetail: Print its sticker again: the one on the dashboard shows the old plate.
fleet.vehicles.soldBody: Sold, scrapped, or added by mistake. No work is offered for it any more and no shift starts on it; what it did stays on its record, and its plate is free for whoever carries it now. Not while a shift runs on it or a run waits for it.
